message: The other day, I found myself in a bit of a standoff with my grandkids about storm preparedness. They were more interested in building a fort with the blankets than listening to me explain the importance of having supplies ready. I laughed and thought, well, if they can build a fort, they can help me pack a little emergency kit. Turns out, a few snacks and a flashlight can be a lot more fun when they’re part of a game! Do your kids have any creative ways to help out when prepping for a storm? 🏰
